title: Recipe
description: Data schema for node crafting and weapon refinement recipes in Cardinal Weapon Framework.

id.description: Unique identifier for the crafting recipe.

itemId.description: Item FormID or Editor ID required as ingredient.

outputFormId.description: Optional output weapon form or item ID produced by this recipe.

requiredStation.description: Optional keyword or bench identifier required to craft (e.g., 'CraftingForge', 'CraftingSkyforge').
